paint.shared.dialogs.project

Class ProjectPathsPanel

  • java.lang.Object
    • paint.shared.dialogs.project.ProjectPathsPanel

  • public class ProjectPathsPanel
extends Object
    Panel allowing users to select the Project Root and Images Root directories.

    The panel exposes browse buttons, text fields, and callback hooks. It notifies listeners when the text changes or when browse actions complete.
